sections.text: Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and the qualified stuff should be carry the 
 suitable safety category .

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass 
 ... etc.
Boiler out of service.
Provide the working area by good lighting.

items: Check on the fixation points for tubes
Check on the tubes surfaces for carbon and sulfur layers
Examine the heating surface for erosion
Examine the heating surface for cracks

The tube section should be saw-cut to prevent any slag from flowing inside the 
sample or the good section of tubing.

The sample should be cut approximately 8-10 inches above and below the affected 
area.

Tubes should be 
numbered and counted from east to west and north to south.

The wall and elevation 
should be noted and marked on the tube.

An arrow should be 
marked to indicate which end of the sample is up.

On a universal pressure 
unit, the sample should be identified as either first, second, or third 
pass.
